title: frontend-tools: Turn off scripting when OBS is launched in safe mode
body:
<!--- Please fill out the following template, which will help other contributors review your Pull Request. -->

<!--- Make sure you’ve read the contribution guidelines here: https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md -->

### Description
This PR stacks on #13912.  Using the `obs_frontend_is_safe_mode_enabled()` function from that PR to determine if OBS was launched in safe mode, `frontend-tools` will stop scripting from starting when the module is started.

### Motivation and Context
As explained in #13912, architecture changes implemented in the Plugin manager 1.5 PR, dont allow the suppression of certain core modules at launch if safe mode is on. `frontend-tools` provides the scripting engine/environment for OBS, and thus can run third party code at launch, and so this PR turns that off in safe mode.

### How Has This Been Tested?
This has been tested on MacOS and Windows by launching in both normal and safe mode, and confirming that scripting is turned off in safe mode, but active in normal mode.
